children.value: > Fact From Story: FTX went bankrupt on November 11th.
> > Fact From Story: On November 12th, Bankman-Fried directed Wang to send customer funds to Bahamanian regulators, Wang said.
> > > Fact From Story: At the time, customers couldn’t take their funds off the exchange because FTX had run out of money and its servers had been shut down.
> > > Fact From Story: Wang said that Bankman-Fried told him to stall the US lawyers and transfer the funds to Bahamanian regulators, who were more likely to let him stay in control of the company.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Directing funds to a specific location implies an attempt to retain control over those funds.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Directing someone to send funds implies a desire to control those funds.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Bankruptcy is a state of being unable to pay one's debts.
